title: Emperor Weapons Face Off
summary: Ye Fan's friends break through the siege: Li Heishui and another companion, Dongfang Ye, Sheng Huangzi and Ji Ziyue. Using a secret from the ancient Demon King's sea of consciousness that Pang Bo shares, they merge their manifestations into one. Wang Teng clashes with the combined form. Ji Ziyue reveals the Origin Spirit Body, pouring heaven-and-earth energy into Ye Fan at great cost to herself. Jiuli brings out the Jiuli Painting, and Ye Fan's Green Copper moves on its own to shield him. More Emperor weapons join in: an emperor sword, the Chaos Green Lotus, Duan De's Heaven-Swallowing Demon Jar, and Ji Haoyue with the Ji clan's Void Mirror. There is also a mysterious Emperor weapon last seen on the night the Divine King revived. A worn-out elder, most likely the sickly old man, seizes Emperor weapons with the Weapon Secret and tells them to run. Ye Fan uses the Weapon Secret himself to turn an Emperor weapon on his pursuers, and the group escapes.
